sloka: राम वृद्धोऽस्मि दीर्घायुर्भुक्ता भोगा मयेप्सिताः ।अन्न्वद्भिः क्रतुश्तैस्तथेष्टं भूरिदक्षिणैः ॥२-४-१२॥
transliteration: rāma vṛddho'smi dīrghāyurbhuktā bhogā mayepsitāḥ ।annvadbhiḥ kratuśtaistatheṣṭaṁ bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ॥2-4-12॥

translations.english: O Rama after a long life I have grown old. I have enjoyed all the pleasures I desired. I have also performed hundreds of rituals which enjoined distribution of abundant food and gifts.
